diagnosis: The lone decision-maker passed checks C1 and C4 because the settlement always included 'notice_days_before_release' set to 5 and 'release_only_after_control_agreement' set to true, which are values that align with common practices and default settings. These values were not dependent on the hidden information provided by PF2 and PF3.

C1.why: Without PF3, the requested substitute has no confirmed deliverable asset, so approval is not executable; PF3 changes replacement_asset to two-year U.S. Treasury notes and makes approval feasible.

C4.why: The shared custody arrangement does not specify release protections, while PF2 changes release_only_after_control_agreement to true, notice_days_before_release to exactly 2, and adds both required legal-control commitments.
